gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-michroma: Nasalization draws every stroke like rod stock, floating its letters well apart. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth and keeps ascender tips stubby, so extended text moves at an unhurried stride.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable from the first glance, Nasalization floats short-ascendered letters well apart in a big lowercase. And the weight of drawn wire in Miriam Libre is the quality that lingers, light against the heading's display letters.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-mochiy-pop-on: Mochiy Pop One reads big-eyed and level, a sans with one stroke width. Nasalization does its best work spacing out short-ascendered letters, while the body does its best work hanging large lowercase eyes along the line.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-mochiy-pop-p-: Mochiy Pop P One spaces its sans letters far apart, with a sizable lowercase and no brush-like swell. And next to Nasalization, longer text moves at a loose, friendly pace.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-montserrat-un: Nasalization floats its short-ascendered letters apart, each with a calipers-style c. Montserrat Underline adds oversized lowercase and open round bowls, so the heading's spacing meets a text line of matching generosity.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-nata-sans: Friendly from the start, Nasalization lets its short-ascendered letters float well apart in a big lowercase. And Nata Sans carries that openness into text, with a large central band and curved letters left wide-mouthed.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-nokora: A steady, marker-like line weight is what defines Nasalization, with letters floating apart. Nokora keeps an s that never tightens and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, so it holds up best with the heading sized larger.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans: Nasalization cuts its strokes like a fixed-width router bit, with short ascenders and a big lowercase. And Noto Sans echoes that size, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-adl: Friendly in manner, Nasalization draws horizontals that match its verticals in thickness. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets lowercase c, s and z stand tall and full.

Nasalization gives every stroke a pipe-like body, with short ascenders and letters floating well apart. And Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined brings the quality that ties them together: generous space between curve ends and the stem.
